title: Omega Games
text: Omega Games is a forum run by KangarooPrecise with co owner K124659. Then both helped get the forum to rise in rankings! The fast growing forum has many topic, the first one is " Keep A Word Drop A Word " and the first club is " Omega Elites ". Most games titles are in 3 axis. X, Y, and Z. Which means the titles are 3D, majority of the games are popular like Accumulation Asy, or originals which means they started in Omega Games! There are a lit of originals, such as Warmer, Warmer, Colder, Colder or Boggle! Omega Games even has a movie studio where they make movies!
